## Description

 
#### What type of PR is this?

/kind bug
 

#### What this PR does / why we need it:

In clusterqueue.go, when  quota.LendingLimit  is  nil ,  lending  variable defaults to  0  instead of  math.Inf(1) .

Prometheus metric  kueue_cluster_queue_lending_limit  reports  0  (interpreted as lending disabled), contradicting actual scheduling behavior  (unrestricted lending).

When  LendingLimit  is  nil ,  localQuota  evaluates to  0 .  Consequently,  sharedQuota  equals entire  nominalQuota  ( delta = nominalQuota - 0 = nominalQuota ). 
Scheduling code allows lending out 100% of nominal quota to Cohort.

Sibling metric  BorrowingLimit  correctly handles  nil  by reporting  math.Inf(1)  ( +Inf ).



#### Which issue(s) this PR fixes:

## Walkthrough

This PR adds lending limit metric reporting to cluster queue resource metrics. The scheduler explicitly reports positive infinity when lending limit is unset, delegating to the configured value otherwise. Test coverage and documentation validate and describe the metric behavior.

## Changes

**Lending Limit Metric Reporting**

|Layer / File(s)|Summary|

|**Metric emission and documentation** <br> `pkg/cache/scheduler/clusterqueue.go`, `pkg/metrics/metrics.go`, `site/content/en/docs/reference/metrics.md`, `site/content/zh-CN/docs/reference/metrics.md`|`reportResourceMetrics` assigns `lending = math.Inf(1)` when `LendingLimit` is nil.   `@weizhoublue`, you're absolutely right — I apologize for the incorrect review. The [Go 1.26 release notes](https://go.dev/doc/go1.26) confirm that the built-in `new` function now accepts an expression as its operand (specifying the initial value), so `new(resource.MustParse("3"))` is perfectly valid Go 1.26 syntax. My concern was based on pre-1.26 semantics.
